_about: Sound effect ids. 'file' is what plays; swap in real audio by changing the path (keep loop false for one-shots). Everything here is a PLACEHOLDER tone built by scripts/tools/make_voice_syllables.py. See docs/audio_requests.md.

bubble_open.note: Speech bubble pops open: soft rising bloop.

bubble_next.note: Advance to the next bubble: tiny soft tick.

red_thumbs_up.note: Red's thumbs-up gesture: cloth swish into a happy boop.

red_head_shake.note: Red's head-shake gesture: two swishes with a low 'nuh-uh' boop.

battle_ding.note: THE Clutch cue. Very short, sharp and bright; peak inside the first ~10 ms so the press never feels late.

battle_hit.note: Basic hit: a chunky cartoon thump with a noisy crack.

battle_hit_big.note: Big hit: heavier, longer thump and clank for boss and big-attack damage.

battle_rating_nice.note: Nice!: two small bright bell notes rising. Quietest of the three ratings.

battle_rating_rad.note: Rad!: a quick rising three-note arpeggio with sparkle. Louder and fuller than Nice.

battle_rating_totally_rad.note: TOTALLY RAD!: loudest sound in a fight. Big rising run, stacked chord, crash splash, zip and boom.

battle_perfect_block.note: Perfect Block!: a ringing clank that sustains with a bright ting.

battle_payback.note: Payback!: perfect-block ring, a whoosh, then a punchy counter-hit.

battle_ko.note: K.O. freeze-frame slam: huge boom, crash and a rumbling tail (~1.5 s).

battle_down.note: Down for the Count: a goofy descending bwomp, wobble and dull thud.

battle_flee.note: Run away: comic scramble of quick footsteps speeding up, a zip and a puff.

battle_heal.note: Heal: soft rising sparkles over a warm shimmer.

battle_static_in.note: Fight starts: radio static sweeping up into a sharp snap.

battle_static_out.note: Fight ends: a thump then radio static whooshing away.

battle_victory.note: Victory jingle (~2 s): original rising arpeggio, little turn, big held C chord with a cymbal.

battle_game_over.note: Game over: four sagging 'wah' notes and a long comic droop. Deflated, not grim.

battle_menu_open.note: Battle command menu opens: tiny bright rising chirp.

combat_swing_light.note: Light sword swing: a fast thin air-slice with a snick at the front. Fires constantly, so it sits low.

combat_swing_heavy.note: Heavy sword swing: a big low cleaving swoosh with weight under it.

combat_hit_light.note: Light hit: a snappy crunchy smack, thump plus crack.

combat_hit_heavy.note: Heavy hit: deep thump, thick body, hard crack and a steel clank. Must feel powerful.

combat_hit_launch.note: Launcher hit: a hard crack then a rising whoosh-crack that sends the enemy up.

combat_hit_air.note: Hit on an airborne enemy: lighter and bouncier, a crisp pop with a bright ping.

combat_parry.note: Parry: a bright metallic ring, blade on blade.

combat_parry_perfect.note: Perfect parry: a bigger ring with a low thud and a rising sparkle shower.

combat_dash.note: Ground dash: a boot scuff and a short whoosh.

combat_air_dash.note: Air dash: thinner and brighter than the ground dash, a rising airy zip.

combat_jump.note: Jump: a push-off scuff, a little rising spring tone and a puff of air.

combat_land.note: Landing: a solid thump on steel grating with a dusty scuff.

combat_lamp_flare.note: Lamp Flare (perfect dodge slow-mo trigger): bright ping, warm bright swell, and a low time-stretch thoom.

combat_lights_on_activate.note: Lights On activation: big and triumphant. Charge zip, boom, crash, wide brassy chord, sparkle shower. Loudest sound in the sandbox.

combat_noise_rank_up.note: Noise rank up: a short punchy sting, five quick steps rising.

combat_lock_on.note: Lock-on: a dry click then two quick rising beeps.

combat_enemy_telegraph.note: Enemy attack telegraph: a sharp dissonant two-stab warning with a metal ping. Cold and urgent.

combat_enemy_death.note: Enemy death: a hard crack, a bit-crushed power-down, a fizz of sparks and a last thud.

combat_brute_slam.note: Brute slam: heavy ground-shaking impact with a clang, rumble tail and debris.

hack_zap_cast.note: Zap Drone launches: a quick whir-up and a bright chirp, light and eager.

hack_zap_fly.note: Zap Drone in flight (loop): a small homemade electric buzz with a wobble.

hack_zap_hit.note: Each of the drone's zaps: a sharp crackle snap with a clean transient (code pitches it up a little on bonus targets).

hack_emp.note: EMP cast and pulse: a fast charge inhale, a deep round whump, crackle spreading out in a ring.

hack_emp_hit.note: Enemy knocked back or stunned by the EMP: a short electric clunk plus a power-down fizz.

hack_overclock_link.note: Overclock takes a machine: data-burst chirps, a lock-in click, a rising tone. The most hacker sound Red has.

hack_overclock_loop.note: Under a hijacked machine for its 10 s (loop): a quiet cyan whine with a soft pulse.

hack_overclock_end.note: The link drops: a descending blip and a fizz.

hack_reboot.note: Reboot: a power-down click, a hair of silence, then a warm rising boot-up chord with a chime.

hack_battery_full.note: Battery full: a tiny bright satisfied chime. Quiet, it happens a lot.

hack_denied.note: Hack refused (not enough charge, or no signal): a dry double blip that says no without scolding.

hack_locked.note: Quiet Hours locks the hacks (jam/lockout fizz): static clamping down, ending in a dry clamp click.

hack_unlocked.note: Hacks come back after Quiet Hours: a clean click-ping.

hack_target_door.note: Fuse-box gate zaps open: a spark, a clunk, the gate grinding open, a last thunk.

hack_target_crane_loop.note: Hijacked crane moving (loop): hydraulic groan and chain rattle.

hack_target_line_off.note: A drone line shuts down: a power-down whine and a last rotor dying.

hack_target_terminal.note: A terminal is used: a fussy Signals beep-chirp.

boss_stomp_windup.note: Leg Stomp telegraph: a rising servo whine and an electric charge hum, ending on ratchet ticks.

boss_stomp_ring.note: Leg Stomp slam and shock ring: a heavy clank, then a crackling ring travelling outward.

boss_sweep_line.note: Dish Sweep line crawling (loop): a thin rising tone with a scanning tick-tick-tick.

boss_sweep_beam.note: Dish Sweep beam (loop): a thick buzzing roar.

boss_drone_drop.note: Drone Drop: a hatch clank, a pneumatic hiss, three rotor spin-ups.

boss_quiet_hours.note: Quiet Hours: the dish hums, a rising whine into a static burst.

boss_quiet_hours_cut.note: Hitting the dish cuts Quiet Hours short: the whine collapsing downward with a pop.

boss_relay_break.note: A relay box bursts: a pop, a spark shower, a dying status beep.

boss_topple.note: The Hushmaster topples: servo groans sagging, metal impacts, then the full crash with a rumble tail. NEW id, not in the first brief (row 23's full crash).

boss_jack_in.note: Red jacks into the dish: a data-dive whoosh, a rising digital roar, then a huge hit. The payoff of phase 1.

boss_kasp_whistle.note: Kasp's whistle: a shrill, slightly wet referee whistle. Comic and officious.

mech_assemble.note: The scrap rises and locks together round Kasp: magnetic hum, scraping, dozens of clamps, a huge final clamp, the floodlight switching on.

scale_switch.note: Scale shift from Red to the colossus: a deep air swell and a low boom underneath the docking sounds.

mech_step.note: Junk mech footfall: a boom plus a shower of rattling scrap.

mech_idle_loop.note: Under the mech (loop): creaking metal, flapping sheets, a rough diesel.

mech_telegraph.note: Every junk mech wind-up: a long low horn blast with scrap rattle. Cold, readable from 75 m.

mech_sting_windup.note: Sting when a mech attack starts (junk_mech.json sting_at_start): a short low horn swell with a rattle. NEW id from the data.

mech_sting_lock.note: Sting when the mech's aim locks (junk_mech.json sting_at_lock): a sharp metallic double stab. NEW id from the data.

mech_swing.note: Mech arm swing (Scrap Swing): a low slow whoosh with debris.

mech_slam.note: Mech slam (Wrecking Drop): the biggest impact in the slice, a ground-shaking boom and a scrap avalanche.

mech_barrage.note: Scrap Barrage: a run of launch thunks, each with a whoosh and clatter. NEW id (the fourth attack).

mech_roar.note: Mech roar (core reveal, last stand): a huge grinding metal growl with steam. NEW id.

mech_plate_break.note: An armour plate tears off and falls: a shrieking tear then a long falling crash.

mech_core_hit.note: A hit on the exposed core: a hollow metal bong, a crack and a zap. NEW id.

mech_core_alarm.note: Core exposed, Kasp's cockpit alarms (loop): panicky Signals beeps over a pulsing low tone.

mech_defeat.note: The mech collapses into a junk pile: an avalanche, a last clang, then one tin can rolling to a stop.

robot_step_small.note: Loader's foot: a heavy metal clomp on grating, thud plus servo whine.

robot_step_huge.note: Colossus's foot: a low slow boom with a rolling tail and distant debris.

robot_hatch.note: Loader's hatch (and hop-in jet puff): pneumatic hiss, rusty hinge clunk, latch.

robot_bay_doors.note: Colossus's chest doors: a huge servo groan with a grind and a klaxon blip.

robot_dock_clank.note: Loader snaps into the bay: one hard clank and ring, then a low clamp thunk 0.6 s later.

robot_power_up.note: Robot powers on: a rising electric hum, furnace roar, three relay ticks.

robot_servo_small_loop.note: Loader idling and moving (loop): a chunky servo hum with a rattle.

robot_servo_huge_loop.note: Colossus idling and moving (loop): a deep hydraulic groan and slow machine breathing.

robot_swing_huge.note: Colossus's arm swing: a huge low whoosh pushing air.

robot_hit_huge.note: Colossus's fist lands on the junk mech: metal crunching into scrap, a boom, falling debris.

robot_smash_scrap.note: Loader smashes scrap, props, cops and drones: a crunchy metal crash with bits scattering (variant A).

robot_smash_scrap_2.note: Loader smash, variant B (a bit more boom).

robot_smash_scrap_3.note: Loader smash, variant C (a bit more clatter).

amb_market_night.note: Night market bed (loop): LOUD and cheerful chatter with laughs, a sizzling wok, a cart bell, string-light hum, a far PA.

amb_market_music.note: Music leaking from a stall's speaker stack (loop, positional): a cheerful tinny tune.

amb_market_radio.note: A chatty counter radio (loop, positional): static, a babbling presenter, a jingle's bleeps.

amb_market_arcade.note: The bootleg arcade (loop, positional): original cabinet bleeps, coins, zips and a win jingle.

amb_market_noodles.note: The noodle cart (loop, positional): wok sizzle, ladle, chopper, bubbling pot, cart bell.

amb_market_charger.note: Grandma's charging stall (loop, positional): mains hum, fan, charge-up pings, a hummed tune.

amb_market_chimes.note: Wind chimes on the tarp poles (loop, positional): bright random bells in a breeze.

amb_market_drones.note: The kids' scrap drones whizzing past (one-shot, positional).

amb_market_patrol.note: A Signals patrol passes (one-shot, 9 s): boots in step, a radio squawk, one whistle.

amb_junkyard.note: Junkyard bed (loop): wind over metal, creaks, far chains, a far crusher, settling scrap, a distant drone. Grim and lonely.

music_market.note: Music stand-in, night market (rooms.json 'market'): sunny, bouncy, major, ~16.6 s loop. Original tune. Feels like a Mega Man Legends town theme.

music_battle_regular.note: Music stand-in, regular fight ('battle_regular'): hot, driving E minor at 156 BPM, ~12.3 s loop.

music_battle_tough.note: Music stand-in, tough fight ('battle_tough'): faster and tenser, A phrygian at 166 BPM, ~11.6 s loop.

music_battle_boss.note: Music stand-in, boss fight ('battle_boss'): pompous brass march at 148 BPM, ~13 s loop.

music_hushmaster.note: Music stand-in, Kasp and the Hushmaster (phase 1): bureaucratic staccato march at 140 BPM, ~13.7 s loop. NEW id.

music_junk_mech.note: Music stand-in, the junk mech (phase 2): heavy lurching C minor chug at 132 BPM, ~14.5 s loop. NEW id.
